annotations.text:
Lilo, rebuilt from your four references only.

Family turned out to be pure black — huge numerals, label/value rows, an icon-only tab bar, a circular add button and a white pill to confirm. That reset the whole thing: every travel app is white, and on black a cover photo stops being decoration and becomes the light source. Luma tints a page with colour drawn from its own cover, which works better on dark than it did on the white ground I had.

So: Family sets the ground, the numerals and the rows. Luma sets creation and the ambient tint. Wise sets money. Grok sets the one input that both adds and answers.

What is gone: the Partiful dock and the GroupMe two-button decision from the last round. You did not ask for those, and they were steering the design. Where an idea has no source in your four, it is not here.

Sample content throughout — names, times, prices and references are invented.

Two trips, two accents.

Each is sampled from its cover and lightened until it clears 4.5:1 on black — Amalfi warm, Tokyo cool. It drives the add button and the trip's links, and nothing else.

A side effect worth having: Lilo cyan finally has the contrast on black that it never had on white, so it can go back to being the app mark without failing anything.
Four arguments, each with the app it came from and what that app actually does. If a source does not convince you, the screens it produced are the ones to throw out.
